Revelations: The series is largely character material. Its blurbs imply that Columbina has a home she once left and now speaks of as home, and that Luonnotar can be brought back into the world by her, but the details belong to the Nod-Krai Archon Quest and are not reconstructed here.

Characters: Columbina, called the Damselette, her kuuhenki, the Traveler and Paimon. Part I also involves a young painter and a mechanic, and Part III involves Luonnotar, as named in the quest blurbs.

Idle dialogue shows Columbina as soft-spoken and unhurried, turning small observations into tales for the kuuhenki. She likes high places and sometimes appears behind the Traveler after the camera pans away. Her own entry carries her full portrayal.

Consequences: Completing a quest gives the New Moon's Embrace effect until the seventh daily reset: while in Nod-Krai, the party's Moonsign Level is Ascendant Gleam, and it cannot be switched off. Completing groups of quests unlocks rewards (Part I: From Here I Gaze, Blueprint: Cloud-Wrapped Moon and Blueprint: Blanket of Stars; Part II: Nod-Krai: Moonlight; Part III: Wings of the Silent Moon). These are gameplay items; they do not change the story.

Placement: Introduced in Version 6.0 (Luna I) with Nod-Krai. After each quest the player waits seven daily resets for the next. The Selenic Chronicles quests become unavailable when A Nocturne of the Far North starts (it begins automatically after Act IV, An Elegy for Faded Moonlight), and become available again after True Moon is completed.

Another Auspicious Moonlit Night Rolls Around
As One Might Stride Betwixt the Clouds (event)
On White Wings Pierce Through Cloud and Fog
Having Met You, My Heart is Gladdened
Next Year's Moon, Just as Bright
772.comment: Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon
772.content:
Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon (also: Moonchase Festival 2026 event, Version 7.1 Moonchase event, World Food Fair event, Another Auspicious Moonlit Night Rolls Around, As One Might Stride Betwixt the Clouds (event), On White Wings Pierce Through Cloud and Fog, Having Met You, My Heart is Gladdened, Next Year's Moon, Just as Bright): This year's Moonchase is organised by Chenyu Vale's associations and replaces the Masterful Chefs contest with a World Food Fair featuring cooks from four nations. While the Millelith and the Lan clan's thaumaturges fight evil spirits stirred up by the festival, Lan Yan and the Traveler help Lan Junming, a remnant soul bound to a rattan figure with a seal he placed himself, recover his lost memory over several days: a poem, a Moon-Viewing Gathering, a promise made with Silverwing. Zhongli reveals what became of her, and Lan Yan performs a final art so that he can rest. Meanwhile, Xiangling, Escoffier and the food-street cooks solve a dispute over Wangxiao Cakes.

Plot: Prologue: Xiangling invites the Traveler and Paimon to Yilong Wharf for the World Food Fair. Escoffier is there for Fontaine, Ningguang has come on official business and Lan Yan shows the Traveler around.

Part I: Lan Yan and the Traveler meet an old man repeating that "Moonchase ought not to be like this". He is a remnant soul in a rattan figure. Tracing Zibai from Baiju Guesthouse to Iron Tongue Tian's storytelling, they find her with Zhongli, and she identifies him as Lan Junming, the Wind Reader, and Zhongli suggests the Moon-Viewing Gathering at Wangshu Inn as the Moonchase he remembers.

Part II: Travelling toward Wangshu Inn they fight possessed monsters with Hu Tao, Xingqiu, Chongyun and Gaming. At the gathering Lan Junming remembers his promise to Silverwing.

Part III: They try to summon Silverwing but she does not come. Zhongli explains her fate, and Lan Yan performs a final art that frees Lan Junming's soul.

Epilogue: Ningguang thanks Lan Yan, swallows are calmer, and the Traveler enjoys the food street.

Revelations: Lan Junming (the Wind Reader, also called Mad Lan) was a thaumaturge counted among the Eight Adepts. With the Red Runt (Wuwang Kid), whose Qihuang Arts he borrowed, he created a ward that repelled evil spirits. Silverwing, the Jade-Plumed Silverwing, carried sigils bearing the ward over Liyue so that he could draw on her adeptal power; each year at the Moonchase Festival the two promised to meet and renew the sigils. He used the forbidden Soul-Binding Art on himself to be able to keep the appointment. Silverwing, born from the spirit of heaven and earth, was embodied in swallows; losses on the long journeys wiped away her memory and mind, and in the end the swallows forgot their promise.

Characters: Main: the Traveler, Paimon, Lan Yan, Lan Junming (remnant soul), Zibai, Zhongli. Lan clan: Lan Yu (clan head) and other elders. Friends: Hu Tao, Xingqiu, Chongyun, Gaming, Xiangling, Guoba. Others: Ningguang, Escoffier, Lu Weng, Iron Tongue Tian, Jiangxue. Adepti: Cloud Retainer (Xianyun), Moon Carver, Mountain Shaper, Madame Ping, Xiao. Silverwing and Wuwang Kid appear only in memory.

Consequences: Lan Junming's remnant soul is released and returns to the Ley Lines. Lan Yan's art, completed at the pavilion east of Teatree Slope, suppresses evil spirits across Liyue, shortens the Millelith's operations and calms the swallows, which should return to nest in Chenyu Vale. Lan Yan finds a "responsibility" of her own, and her clan elders praise her. The Chenyu Vale Confectionery Guild president accepts a new Wangxiao Cake and funds more batches. Xiangling and Escoffier agree to hold a culinary duel at Yilong Wharf every year.

Placement: Released in Version 7.1 as a Flagship Event for the Moonchase Festival, running from 24 September 2026. Requirements were Adventure Rank 20 and the Prologue Act III (Song of the Dragon and Freedom). It takes place after the Frost Moon's return and the revival of Zibai in A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon (6.3), who is by now living at Baiju Guesthouse, and the World Food Fair brings cooks from Mondstadt, Fontaine and Sumeru to Yilong Wharf.

key: Another Auspicious Moonlit Night Rolls Around
773.comment: Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon: Prologue - Another Auspicious Moonlit Night Rolls Around
773.content: Xiangling writes inviting the Traveler to Yilong Wharf. Chenyu Vale's associations organise this year's Moonchase, and with the Lan clan's elders' agreement the Masterful Chefs contest has been replaced by a World Food Fair with representatives from Mondstadt, Fontaine and Sumeru as well as Liyue. Escoffier represents Fontaine. Ningguang says Moonchase has always been shaped by the people, that new customs are folded in and later called tradition, and that she is there on official business: around this time evil forces gather and possess monsters, so the Millelith have mobilised and the Lan clan's thaumaturges will help.

key: As One Might Stride Betwixt the Clouds
774.comment: Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon: Part I - As One Might Stride Betwixt the Clouds
774.content: Lan Yan, who chose the mystic arts as a hobby rather than a duty, shows Paimon and the Traveler around and mentions she is studying a swallow-related art. They meet an old man who keeps saying "Moonchase ought not to be like this", disliking the food street and calling Liyue changed. Lan Yan recognises the Soul-Binding Art, a forbidden clan technique that traps part of a soul in a rattan effigy. A seal blocks her from undoing it. He asks for help finding the Moonchase he remembers, which has nothing to do with cooking, and says Lan Yan's art steadies him. They think of Zibai at Baiju Guesthouse. At Iron Tongue Tian's, Zibai and Zhongli discuss the Moonchase Rite; Zibai recognises him as Mad Lan, the Wind Reader, Lan Junming. She says the technique was invented by Lan Junming himself, and the seal is his own work, so brute force would disperse his soul. Zhongli proposes a Moon-Viewing Gathering at Wangshu Inn in two days. Lan Junming accepts the title "Grandmaster".

key: On White Wings Pierce Through Cloud and Fog
775.comment: Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon: Part II - On White Wings Pierce Through Cloud and Fog
775.content: Two days later Lan Yan decides to walk the mountain paths with Lan Junming. Near Dihua Marsh they find Gaming, Hu Tao, Xingqiu and Chongyun besieged by possessed monsters; evil spirits born from fallen gods move from monster to monster. Lan Yan organises a spirit-quelling banner and rattan figures to sweep up the spirits. Lan Junming asks after a Tianheng Sect and a Yunlai Sect and finds the martial and thaumaturgic schools of Liyue unlike his memory. At Wangshu Inn Xiao and the fisherman Jiangxue (successor of Fish Creel, the Yunlai Angler) appear, and Xiangling and Smiley Yanxiao provide the Moon-Viewing Gathering's food. Hu Tao recounts a poetry contest in which Wuwang Kid beat Lan Junming with "Through autumn skies, the windborne silverwing chases the moon...". Lan Junming recalls Silverwing: during the Archon War he combined Qimen techniques with the Red Runt's Qihuang Arts to make a ward and inscribed it on sigils for her to carry. They promised to meet each year at Moonchase and renew the art, "seeing off the autumn swallow". The seal can only be lifted when the art is performed once more. They agree on a pavilion east of Teatree Slope two days later.

776.comment: Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon: Part III - Having Met You, My Heart is Gladdened
776.content:
Lan Yu, head of the Lan clan, tells the story of his ancestor: unmarried, he brought his learning home and taught his brothers, and later Moonchase stories speak of a strange man appearing in Yilong Wharf each year. At the pavilion Lan Yan learns the swallow-pattern art that once called Silverwing and, with the Traveler, gathers adeptal energy to reveal the pattern on the water. Silverwing does not come. The art is weakening. The Traveler and Paimon ask the adepti at Mt. Aocang. Nobody knows where she is, except Zhongli, who explains that she was born from the spirit of heaven and earth and that the swallows were her embodiments. In the Archon War she flew between Chenyu Vale and Guyun Stone Forest, resting at Thousand Winds Temple, and swallows died on every trip. She lost pieces of her mind and memory with them, until the swallows forgot their promise to Lan Junming. He compares her to a ship all of whose parts have been replaced.

Lan Yan decides to tell Lan Junming the truth and lift the seal. She performs a recreated version of the art at night, while Lan Junming sings of his promise and of his love of the scenery he saw in her eyes. The seal opens, his remnant soul returns to the Ley Lines, and Zibai and Zhongli say he was a rare character who found peace.

777.comment: Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon: Epilogue - Next Year's Moon, Just as Bright
777.content: Ningguang thanks Lan Yan before the Lan elders, saying that an unseen force suppressed the evil spirits across Liyue and let the Millelith finish early and go home for the festival. The elders praise her ability, and she says Hu Tao and Chongyun helped. Lan Yan is rescued from her elders by the Traveler. Zhongli says the swallows seem less frantic. The group goes to the food street. Lan Yan says Moonchase events change yearly but Xiangling and Escoffier will hold a yearly duel at Yilong Wharf, so good food and good friends are guaranteed.

778.comment: Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon: Food Street Must Be Saved!
778.content: The Wondrous Anecdotes chapter with three quests: The Chefs From a Foreign Land, Deliciousness Knows No Borders and A Taste Beyond Time. The Fontainian chefs Savanna and Escoffier and Liyue's Smiley Yanxiao and Xiangling test each other's cooking until the president of the Chenyu Vale Confectionery Guild demands every stall sell Five-Nut Wangxiao Cakes. The cooks and friends team up to bake a better one, the Celestial Tea Crisp, using Glaze Lily nectar and tea extract. A taste of the authentic Five-Nut cake moves him because it recalls childhood and sharing food with family, but he judges the Celestial Tea Crisp a cut above and the Guild pays for more batches. Zibai, passing by, recalls Fullmoon Cakes she ate thousands of years ago.

779.comment: Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon: Soul-Binding Art
779.content: A Lan clan technique that traps part of a person's soul in a rattan effigy to create a puppet the caster commands. Later generations banned it. Lan Junming used it on himself to leave a remnant soul able to keep a yearly appointment, adding a seal to bind the technique. The remnant soul slowly fades and can only be released when the art is performed once more.

780.comment: Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon: Silverwing (Jade-Plumed Silverwing)
780.content: An adeptus born of the energy of heaven and earth whose living manifestations were Liyue's swallows. She carried Lan Junming's wards across the land during the Archon War and kept a yearly promise to meet him at Moonchase. The toll of the journeys wiped away her mind and memory, and the swallows now fly Liyue by instinct. The wiki counts her among the Eight Adepts.

key: Sea of Clouds, Sea of People
781.content:
Sinae Unicornis Chapter (Ganyu) (also: Sinae Unicornis Chapter, Ganyu's Story Quest, Sea of Clouds, Sea of People): The Sinae Unicornis Chapter is Ganyu's Story Quest (Version 1.2), set in Liyue. In its one act, Sea of Clouds, Sea of People, Ganyu, half qilin and half human, doubts whether she belongs in Liyue Harbor as a secretary to the Liyue Qixing or among the adepti. After training with the adepti and helping a colleague investigate tax fraud, she chooses to keep her post.

The act has three quests: The Illuminated Beast of the Sea of Clouds, A Secretary in a Sea of Humanity and A Pact That Crosses Time. It requires Adventure Rank 40 and the Archon Quest A New Star Approaches. The Chinese title means roughly "Chapter of the Immortal Qilin".

Plot: At Yujing Terrace, Ningguang's secretaries Baixiao, Baishi and Baiwen ask the Traveler to find Ganyu, who has gone to Jueyun Karst convinced she has been replaced. The Cloud Retainer and Xiao give her trials, and a pilgrim's reaction to her refusal to grant a blessing deepens her doubts. Back in Liyue Harbor, with Uncle Tian's daughter Huixin, Ganyu exposes two rival shopkeepers' tax evasion by turning them on each other, after a comic clash with a berry-picking Fatui skirmisher. Huixin tells her that her family has long looked up to her, and Ganyu resolves to stay on as a Qixing secretary.

Revelations: Minor: Uncle Tian is the Tianshu of the Liyue Qixing, though few know it. Ganyu feels set apart from both adepti and humans, more strongly than others realise. The Fatui's reputation in Liyue is poor after Childe released Osial.

Characters: Ganyu, the Traveler and Paimon. Baixiao, Baishi, Baiwen, the Cloud Retainer, Xiao, Xin Cheng, Uncle Tian, Huixin, Bolai, Dongsheng, Master Lu and a Fatui skirmisher appear.

Ganyu is dutiful and self-doubting; the secretaries are harried and fond of her; Xiao is brusque but takes her training seriously; Huixin looks up to her; Tian is relaxed and shrewd.

Consequences: Ganyu stays at her post as the Qixing's secretary and deepens her trust in the Traveler. The act also gives a first look at the Cloud Retainer's and Xiao's attitudes toward her.

Placement: Release order: 1.2. Story order: after Chapter I of the Archon Quests (A New Star Approaches).

key: Sea of Clouds Sea of People
Illuminated Beast of the Sea of Clouds
782.comment: Sinae Unicornis Chapter (Ganyu): Sea of Clouds, Sea of People
782.content: Act I of Ganyu's Story Quest. Ganyu doubts whether she belongs among humans or adepti, takes trials from the Cloud Retainer and Xiao, assists Huixin with a tax investigation, and decides to continue working for the Qixing.

783.content:
Sol Invictus Chapter (Mavuika) (also: Sol Invictus, As the Blazing Sun, Mavuika's Story Quest): Mavuika's Story Quest, set the day after the war with the Abyss ends. The Wayob warn that the first Pyro Archon, Xbalanque, is returning to Natlan. During the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame, now reworked as a friendly tournament, Mavuika finds Xbalanque living in the body of a boy named Mausau, duels him in a spirit arena and wins, and declines his offer of life force to meet someone from the Night Kingdom.

The chapter has a single act, As the Blazing Sun, released in Version 5.3 and requiring the Archon Quest act Incandescent Ode of Resurrection. Its quests are After the Peace, A New Pilgrimage and Hearken, Ye Who Have Returned. It is a calm, comic follow-up to the war and shows Mavuika at ease in peacetime with the Traveler and the tribes.

Plot: Citlali wakes the Traveler and Paimon the morning after the war and brings them to Mavuika, who says the Wayob in the Night Kingdom have told Citlali that Xbalanque is returning. Mavuika has turned the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame into a friendly competition and hopes it will draw him out. She and the Traveler visit the tribes, then the tournament runs at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame and Kinich wins it. Mavuika identifies Xbalanque in the crowd inside the body of a boy called Mausau, speaks to him privately, and agrees to a duel in a spirit arena. She wins narrowly. She declines his gift of life force, they ride her Flamestrider together, and at day's end he departs; Mausau wakes remembering a dream.

Revelations: Xbalanque can return, but only for a single day and only inside a living body. His deal with the Ruler of Death let Natlan follow its own rules for the long war. Mavuika's family, comrades and friends who died are said to still call to her and watch over her from the winds.

Characters: Mavuika leads the story; the Traveler and Paimon accompany her. Xbalanque is the visitor. Citlali, Kinich, Ajaw, Mualani, Kachina, Ororon, Xilonen, Chasca and Iansan appear as the heroes of their tribes, and Mausau is the boy whose body Xbalanque borrows.

Consequences: Kinich wins the reworked Pilgrimage. Xbalanque leaves at the end of the day and Mausau resolves to train for the next tournament. Mavuika has again chosen to keep the dead in memory.

Placement: Released in Version 5.3 as a Story Quest. It requires the Archon Quest act Incandescent Ode of Resurrection and Adventure Rank 40, and is set right after the war with the Abyss ends.

784.content: The first Pyro Archon returns for one day in the body of a boy named Mausau, enters the Pilgrimage tournament, and duels Mavuika in a spirit arena. He loses narrowly, offers his remaining life force, and leaves at dusk. Mausau is left unharmed.

785.content: A boy who takes part in the Pilgrimage tournament and, unknown to him, is possessed by Xbalanque. He wakes after the feast remembering a very vivid dream and decides to train for the next Pilgrimage.

786.content: Braziers that Natlan sets up to guide people home at night. Those returning light them themselves, and the light shows the tribe that the person has made it back.

787.comment: Sol Invictus Chapter (Mavuika): As the Blazing Sun Event Window
787.content: The Story Quest event ran from 2025-01-01 to 2025-01-21 with extra rewards for completing the chapter via Story Key. The story remains available afterwards.

key: Song of the Dragon and Freedom
788.comment: Song of the Dragon and Freedom
788.content:
Song of the Dragon and Freedom (also: Prologue Act III, Prologue: Act III, Dvalin purification act): The act opens with the Abyss Order's mage dealt with at the winery, which frees Venti to dispel the barrier over Stormterror's Lair. Inside the lair, an old structure from Decarabian's Mondstadt, the group activates a light mechanism that Venti imbues with Anemo energy, and the Traveler purges Dvalin of the corrupting energy. Dvalin asks why Venti never asked for his protection, and flies away reassured. Jean explains the misunderstanding to the people.

Meanwhile hilichurls and Abyss infiltrators attack the city; Amber and the Knights hold, and Kaeya intercepts infiltrators. After Barbara receives the Holy Lyre der Himmel, a Fatui ambush freezes Venti and takes the Anemo Gnosis from him: Signora, the Eighth Harbinger, tears it out of his chest. Venti then explains the Gnosis, Signora's rank and the Tsaritsa, and advises the Traveler to meet the Geo Archon in Liyue at the Rite of Descension.

Plot: **Preparation.** With the Abyss mage killed at the winery, Venti can dispel the barrier over Stormterror's Lair, and he and the Traveler go in to cleanse Dvalin.

**Dvalin purified.** The Traveler catches up with Dvalin and purges the corrupt energy. Dvalin protects the group and asks Venti why he did not ask for protection. Venti says he did not want him to obey the Abyss Order, nor to obey Venti either; an order to be free would not be true freedom. Dvalin leaves, assured that no one is after him. Jean tells the people that the dragon had not attacked for no reason.

**The city.** The Knights repel a hilichurl attack on Mondstadt while Kaeya intercepts Abyss Order infiltrators; Amber wishes the Traveler luck on their journey to meet the Seven.

**The Gnosis.** At the Cathedral Jean introduces the deaconess Barbara, who asks for the lyre. The Traveler hands over a damaged one and Barbara panics; Venti repairs it and Barbara leaves with it. Venti says he only used magic to make it appear fixed and runs off. Outside a cold gust freezes Venti and Paimon. Fatui Agents restrain the Traveler; Signora and two Fatui Cicin Mages arrive, and Signora, after trading insults with Venti, rips out his Gnosis and leaves before the Knights arrive. An agent strikes the Traveler unconscious.

**Aftermath.** Barbara finds them but her healing does not help Venti, who leaves. Jean guesses his purpose; the Traveler stays silent for her sake. They find Venti at the great tree in Windrise, where he explains the Gnosis, Signora as the eighth of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, and the Tsaritsa, the Archon of Snezhnaya who is also one of the Seven. He says the Seven used to respect each other but a catastrophe five hundred years ago broke the relationship, and advises heading to Liyue to see the Geo Archon at the Rite of Descension.

Revelations: - The ruins that Dvalin took refuge in are part of old Mondstadt from Decarabian's time.
- Dvalin was cleansed of the Abyss Order's corruption and was not to blame for the attacks on the city. He wanted to know why Venti never asked him for help.
- The Anemo Gnosis was taken from Venti by Signora, the Eighth of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers.
- Venti reluctantly explains what the Gnosis is, and Paimon realises that the Tsaritsa of Snezhnaya, who gave the Harbingers their power, is one of the Seven.
- Kaeya learns that the Abyss Order has a single leader.

Characters: Traveler and Paimon; Venti (the Anemo Archon, Barbatos, who has by now revealed his identity); Dvalin, cleansed of the corruption; Jean (Acting Grand Master); Diluc (brings word of the Abyss Order; his people track the Abyss mage); Amber and Kaeya (the defence of the city, the tavern conversation); Barbara (receives the lyre); Signora (antagonist) with two Fatui Cicin Mages and Fatui Agents.

Consequences: Dvalin is free of the Abyss Order's influence and the dragon crisis ends. Venti loses the Anemo Gnosis to the Fatui, and the Traveler is set on the road to Liyue to meet the Geo Archon at the Rite of Descension, leading directly into Chapter I.

Placement: Third and last act of the Prologue (release 1.0). It follows For a Tomorrow Without Tears and leads into Chapter I Act I, Of the Land Amidst Monoliths, set in Liyue.

789.comment: Song of the Dragon and Freedom: Signora takes the Anemo Gnosis
789.content: After the Dvalin episode Signora, the Eighth Fatui Harbinger, ambushes Venti outside the Favonius Cathedral with Fatui Agents and Cicin Mages. A freezing wind immobilises Venti and Paimon; she insults him, then pushes her arm into his chest and removes his Gnosis. The Traveler is struck unconscious. Barbara later finds them, but Venti walks away.

790.comment: Song of the Dragon and Freedom: Dvalin purified
790.content: In the lair, the Traveler purges the Abyss-Order corruption from Dvalin, who asks Venti why he never requested his protection. Venti answers that commanded freedom would not be freedom. Dvalin flies off, and Jean explains to Mondstadt that the dragon had been misunderstood.

791.comment: Song of the Dragon and Freedom: Kaeya on the Abyss Order's leader
791.content: While others fight at the ruins, Kaeya stays in the city to counter a suspected diversion and intercepts Abyss Order infiltrators. He learns that the Order has one leader. Amber thinks he abandoned duty for a drink.

792.content:
Song of the Welkin Moon (also: Welkin Moon chapter, Song of the Empty Moon, Nod-Krai Archon Quest, Luna Archon Quest): The chapter runs from a prelude in Natlan (version 5.8) through ten acts (6.0-6.6). It follows the Traveler's search for clues about their spaceship while Nod-Krai is threatened by the Wild Hunt, by Rerir, and by Fatui who have moved in under Dottore and Sandrone. Columbina, the weakened Moon Goddess, is the emotional centre: friends restore her strength and her name, and she in turn helps them. Dottore then steals the power of the three moons and attacks Nod-Krai and, ultimately, Sumeru's Irminsul, with Sandrone's death and Dottore's end as the cost. It was never officially called Chapter VI.

Plot: **Prelude: The Journey Home (5.8).** In Natlan the Traveler and Paimon find Ineffa, an automaton looking for them, and learn of a message from Varka telling them to come to Nod-Krai.

**Acts I-II (6.0).** In Nasha Town they meet Flins, Lauma, Aino and Nefer. A Moon Marrow ends up carried by the Traveler, and a shape-shifting phantom linked to the Wild Hunt is traced to Rerir.

**Acts III-IV (6.1).** Rerir, one of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, attacks Columbina. Allies recover the Iridescent Marrow with Arlecchino's help, delve into Rerir's past, and cast him out of Teyvat.

**Acts V-VI (6.2).** Columbina is fading; she is given a name, enjoys Moon-Prayer Night and is lost after Dottore's ambush (Act VI has its own entity).

**Acts VII-VIII (6.3).** Dottore captures the Traveler; Columbina recovers help in the moon's reflection and returns to defeat him; Sandrone dies.

**Acts IX-X (6.6).** In Sumeru, Nahida and her allies stop an Irminsul crisis traced to Dottore.

Revelations: - Nod-Krai is soaked in kuuvahki, the primordial power of the moons, and the Traveler's spaceship crashed there.
- The Moon Goddess is Columbina; Rerir is a Khaenri'ahn who served King Irmin and was sent out of Teyvat in Act IV.
- Dottore built an artificial Moon Marrow and a false moon and was destroyed in Act VIII; his larger experiment moved to Sumeru's Irminsul.
- The Heavenly Principles placed the Traveler's spaceship on the Frost Moon.

Characters: Traveler and Paimon; Columbina (the Moon Goddess); Lauma and the Frostmoon Scions; Ineffa and Aino; Flins; Nefer and Jahoda of the Curatorium; Varka (Mondstadt's Grand Master and Knight of Boreas); Sandrone and Arlecchino of the Fatui; Rerir (antagonist); Dottore (antagonist); Dainsleif, Albedo and Durin; Nicole and Alice of the Hexenzirkel; Wanderer, Nahida and the Sumeru allies in Acts IX-X.

Consequences: The Frost Moon is back in Teyvat's sky, Columbina lives on Hiisi Island, Nod-Krai forms a joint League, and Dottore and Sandrone are dead. Sumeru keeps functioning under Aaru; Irminsul has been burned, and the Pyro Gnosis has gone.

Placement: Released as a prelude in 5.8 and Acts I-X across Luna I-VII (6.0-6.6), the chapter follows Chapter V (Natlan) and precedes Chapter VII (Snezhnaya), which opens in 7.0. Story order matches release order.

793.comment: Song of the Welkin Moon: Rerir
793.content: A Khaenri'ahn, one of the Five Sinners, who served King Irmin and was once engaged to Tholindis. He attacks Columbina and the Moon Marrows in Acts III-IV, is cast out of Teyvat through a moon gate in Act IV, and is later met in the moon's reflection.

794.comment: Song of the Welkin Moon: Dottore's false moon
794.content: Dottore ambushes Columbina's return to the moon, steals the power of the three moons, replaces the Frost Moon in the sky with a false one, and is destroyed by Columbina and the Traveler in Act VIII.

795.comment: Song of the Welkin Moon: Columbina restored
795.content: Columbina, the weakened Moon Goddess, lives at Silvermoon Hall and is saved by friends who give her a name, a festival farewell and, in Act VIII, the return of her full power. Afterwards she lives with the Frostmoon Scions on Hiisi Island.

796.comment: Song of the Welkin Moon: Sumeru Irminsul crisis
796.content: Dottore's experiment corrupts Irminsul. Nahida takes the strain, Sumeru City is evacuated, and the Seven Pillars help open Aaru as a replacement. The Pyro Gnosis burns the corrupted Irminsul.

key: The Shining Warriors Take the Stage
797.content:
Soulblazers' Snowbound Journey (also: Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge, The Shining Warriors Take the Stage, Now's No Time for Tears, Go, Fietena, Go!): The story has three parts. In The Shining Warriors Take the Stage, the Traveler and Paimon reach the Dragonspine camp, meet Amber and Heinz of the organizing committee, and discover that Varesa and Xilonen are competing with Alrani, Tang Yigang and Minnie as the Soulblazers. In Now's No Time for Tears, the Traveler is initiated into the Legion, trains with the team, and helps convince Minnie's parents to let her race. In Go, Fietena, Go!, Yigang falls ill, the Traveler runs in his place, and Minnie leaves the race to help an injured rival.

Plot: Part I, The Shining Warriors Take the Stage. A letter announces the contest, with teams from Natlan, Sumeru, Inazuma, Liyue and Mondstadt. At the camp Amber and Heinz of the Knights of Favonius, both on the organizing committee, mention a Natlan team with a horned, hungry competitor and a girl with a striped tail; the Traveler recognises Varesa and Xilonen. Their camp is run by Alrani and Tang Yigang, members of the Legion of Soulblazers, a fan club for the comic The Soulblazer Saga. Xilonen explains she is representing her pupil Nepecha; Minnie, a Mondstadt fan, proposed the contest. Part II, Now's No Time for Tears. After a morning initiation ceremony, the Traveler trains on the course, learns of Minnie's deal with her parents, visits the Mondstadt Library, eats at Good Hunter, and watches Minnie's parents and brother ask her to come home. Xilonen then speaks to the parents. Part III, Go, Fietena, Go! Yigang is bedridden with a fever, so the Traveler runs the second leg. During the race Minnie turns back to help an Inazuman runner, the team places too low for a medal, and the committee gives an honorary medal.

Revelations: The Soulblazer Saga is a 12-volume comic series published by the Yae Publishing House. According to Varesa it is an entertainment adaptation of Natlan's history in which Fietena and a group of fellow warriors fight the Abyss. Fan communities of the series span Mondstadt, Natlan and Sumeru through letters and pen friends. Minnie's parents' objections come from worry about her health and her future; they relent once she meets the deal.

Characters: Main: the Traveler, Paimon, Varesa, Xilonen, Minnie, Alrani, Tang Yigang. Also: Amber, Heinz, Lisa, Draff (the referee), Sara, and Minnie's family (Patton, Sherilyn and Moritz); the Inazuman contestant Kenzou; Fietena, Mavuika and others appear only in the comic sequence.

Consequences: Minnie's family allows her to travel abroad on the condition that she is careful. The Soulblazers earn an honorary medal. The event ends with plans to return for the next cross country challenge; Alrani also brings Amber a copy of a Soulblazer comic.

Placement: Released in Version 6.2 ("A Nocturne of the Far North"), 19 December 2025 to 5 January 2026. Entry requires Prologue Act III, Song of the Dragon and Freedom; the Tribal Chronicles A Prayer for Blessings, Told to Crested Peaks and Mushroom Realm Mystery are recommended. It takes place in Mondstadt and Dragonspine and does not affect main-story canon.

798.comment: Soulblazers' Snowbound Journey: Legion of Soulblazers
798.content: A fan club for the comic The Soulblazer Saga. Alrani and Tang Yigang use dramatic tenets drawn from the series; Varesa says its real purpose is to share life's joys and get rid of life's woes. The members in this event are Alrani, Tang Yigang, Minnie, Varesa, and Xilonen as stand-in for Nepecha; the Traveler and Paimon are inducted in Part II.

799.comment: Soulblazers' Snowbound Journey: The Soulblazer Saga
799.content: A long-running comic series with 12 volumes in the main series and spinoffs, including an armoured-mecha spinoff, Armored Assault. The central heroine is Fietena, a warrior who becomes a commander and who fights alongside friends; the Pyro Archon also appears in it. Varesa says it adapts Natlan history for entertainment.

800.comment: Soulblazers' Snowbound Journey: Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge
800.content: A relay race on Dragonspine. Teams include The Sand Blasters, Lightning Strike, The Sunset Squadron, The Frostbite Friends, Dragonspine Must Be Scaled, The Mild Hunt and the Soulblazers, run by an organizing committee that includes Amber and Heinz of the Knights of Favonius. Draff is the referee.

801.content: Minnie, the youngest in her family and a sickly child, promised her parents that if her team is ranked in the race they must take her ambition of working with comics seriously. The parents are loving but anxious; Xilonen persuades them with a group painting from Nepecha's fans. Minnie stops mid-race to help an injured runner, and her father says she achieved what she set out to do, so the parents honour the deal.

key: Liyue Celebrates and Eight Adepts Face a Hidden Calamity
802.content:
Springtime Charms (also: Springtime Charms event, Swirling Butterflies, Lantern Rite 2025, Liyue Celebrates and Eight Adepts Face a Hidden Calamity, Sanctification of Tao Dou): Alongside the story the event offered four festival activities (Immortal Combat, Drills by Lamplight, Custom Gift Envelopes and Festive Travel Journal) whose Festive Fever points unlocked Xiangling's outfit "New Year's Cheer" and a choice of 4-star Liyue character. The narrative runs in four "stanzas" under the heading Swirling Butterflies. It ends warmly: Hu Tao lives, the fetor is contained, Yun Jin performs the rite as a stage piece, and the adepti gather over tea to talk about Hu Tao.

Plot: First Stanza, Liyue Celebrates and Eight Adepts Face a Hidden Calamity: at Wangsheng Funeral Parlor Hu Tao (in a new outfit from Xiangling) says only that she is busy. The Traveler meets Lan Yan, a young woman from Chenyu Vale, and hears the legend of Tao Dou, a tree god of the Archon War. Several people who visited Qingce Village collapse, including Timaeus and the patriarch of the Feiyun Commerce Guild, and Baizhu suspects one cause for all of them.

Second Stanza, The Funeral Parlor Has No Master, Yujing Terrace Calls the Troops: Hu Tao has not returned and Qiqi is missing after gathering herbs, with Wuwang Hill the lead. With Xiao's help the Traveler breaks into the "border" and finds Hu Tao, Lan Yan and Qiqi. Back in Yujing Terrace it is revealed that Hu Tao and Ningguang plan a Sanctification of Tao Dou to purge the fetor.

Third Stanza, Qimen Arts and the Rite of Homa, the Spirits are Calmed and Life Restored: friends take positions at the gates of the array (Terrain at Dihua Marsh, Repose at Qingce Village, Initiation at Liyue Harbor, Death at Wuwang Hill, plus the Gate of Injury in the Chasm). Hu Tao herself must be the obscured person at the centre of the rite. The Traveler cannot be linked to the ley lines, goes after Hu Tao anyway, finds the Gate of Death and pulls her out of the border.

Final Stanza, The Sanctification of Tao Dou: with the crisis contained, Yun Jin performs the rite as a stage piece at Yilong Wharf, and short epilogue scenes follow.

Revelations: The fetor sickening Liyue is connected to the earlier Wuwang Hill disaster, in which Hu Tao's father died using the Art of Homa. The Sanctification of Tao Dou is traditionally believed to require a death, because the Lone Butterfly sacrificed herself in the original rite; Hu Tao argues a scaled-down version only needs the central person to withstand a huge blast of fetor. The Traveler is invisible to the ley lines, which is why the Traveler cannot be the obscured one. No Abyss involvement is sensed.

Characters: Hu Tao is the focus, shown at her most serious beneath her jokes. Lan Yan, a Chenyu Vale rattan-figure maker, is introduced here. Ningguang and Keqing coordinate the Qixing side; Baizhu and Qiqi handle the sick; Xiao and Yelan guard borders and gates; Zhongli quietly supports Hu Tao and the Traveler. Xiangling, Xingqiu, Chongyun, Gaming, Yun Jin, Ganyu, Xianyun and Beidou have smaller roles.

Consequences: Hu Tao survives, the fetor is contained and the sick recover. Ningguang's worry that a greater power may be behind the fetor is left open. Hu Tao's friends see how heavily her family history weighs on her.

Placement: Released in Version 5.3 for the 2025 Lantern Rite. Requirements: Adventure Rank 20 and the Prologue Act III. Recommended first: the Archon Quest Incandescent Ode of Resurrection and the Story Quests Lagenaria Chapter Act I (Baizhu) and Papilio Charontis Chapter Act I (Hu Tao). Because the event runs in Liyue Harbor, its quests can interfere with those Story Quests' character appearances.

803.comment: Springtime Charms: Sanctification of Tao Dou
803.content: In Springtime Charms the Sanctification of Tao Dou is a rite to purge fetor, built on a Seven-and-Eight-Gates Array. The array master picks one of eight gates to subdue the evil by using the ley lines to obfuscate themselves, removing themselves from the lines and carrying the evil with them. The traditional reading is that the person dies, because the Lone Butterfly sacrificed herself; Hu Tao leads a scaled-down version in which she must withstand a huge blast of fetor.

804.content: Lan Yan is a young woman from Chenyu Vale who makes rattan figures. In Springtime Charms her grandfather's divination was disturbed by the fetor, and she seeks out Hu Tao. With help from a cousin in the main family branch she links Hu Tao's rattan dolls to the ley lines.

key: In the Name of the Resistance
805.content:
Stillness, the Sublimation of Shadow (also: Chapter II Act II, Amidst Stormy Judgment, In the Name of the Resistance): Stillness, the Sublimation of Shadow is the second act of Chapter II of the Archon Quests, set in Inazuma and released in Version 2.0. It has only two quests. In the first, the Traveler tries to save Thoma from becoming the hundredth person stripped of a Vision under the Vision Hunt Decree, and is crushed in a duel by the Raiden Shogun. In the second, the Traveler and Paimon, now wanted criminals, find the Watatsumi Army's Resistance, help defend it from the Shogun's Army under Kujou Sara, and are invited to Watatsumi Island by Sangonomiya Kokomi.

The act is where the Traveler becomes Inazuma's most wanted criminal and a participant in the war rather than a visitor. It requires two Story Quest openers, one from the Grus Nivis Chapter and one from the Carassius Auratus Chapter, and by number of quests it is the shortest Archon Quest act in the game.

Plot: **Amidst Stormy Judgment.** The Traveler and Paimon return to Komore Teahouse to hear about their next operation from Kamisato Ayaka and Thoma, but Thoma is missing. Ayaka arrives with news that the Tenryou Commission has taken him to the Statue of the Omnipresent God as the hundredth victim of the Vision Hunt Decree, to be marked with a public ceremony attended by the Raiden Shogun. Ayaka is ready to storm in alone, but the Traveler and Paimon point out that any direct action by her would endanger the Yashiro Commission's neutrality, and persuade her to let them go instead.

At the ceremony the Shogun sees the Traveler use Electro power without a Vision. She calls the Traveler an exception and the enemy of eternity, then draws them into an alternate dimension and easily incapacitates them. Thoma distracts her at the critical moment and escapes with the Traveler and Paimon. The Shogun orders the Traveler's arrest and says she will strike twice next time.

**In the Name of the Resistance.** Thoma sends the pair west to the Watatsumi Army, which leads the resistance against the Decree, while he hides at Komore Teahouse inside Yashiro Commission territory. The Resistance's location is secret, so the Traveler has to find it. On the way through the war zone they save a lone soldier, Teppei, from Shogunate troops. He takes them to General Gorou, warning that the Resistance is at a disadvantage because the Shogun's Army has Kujou Sara's leadership. Gorou, impressed by what the Traveler did at the ceremony, welcomes them.

Revelations: The Raiden Shogun treats the Traveler's Electro power without a Vision as a threat in itself, and shows that she can overpower the Traveler almost without effort. The Resistance is led by Kokomi, the Watatsumi Army's leader, and the Shogunate's forces are commanded in the field by Kujou Sara. Yashiro Commission neutrality limits what Ayaka can do openly.

Characters: **Traveler and Paimon**: now criminals in Inazuma, they move from the Kamisato side of events to the Resistance's side.
**Kamisato Ayaka and Thoma**: Ayaka is held back by her commission's neutrality; Thoma is the intended hundredth victim and is saved by the Traveler, then lies low at Komore Teahouse.
**Raiden Shogun**: appears in person at the ceremony, defeats the Traveler in an alternate space and orders their arrest.
**Teppei**: a Resistance soldier rescued by the Traveler, who guides them and wishes to prove himself.
**Gorou**: the Resistance's commanding general, who refuses to give up the Traveler.
**Kujou Sara**: leads the Shogun's Army against the Resistance and challenges the Traveler to a fight of honor.
**Sangonomiya Kokomi**: the Resistance's leader, who arrives with reinforcements and invites the Traveler to Watatsumi Island.

Consequences: The Traveler and Paimon are wanted by the Shogunate, so they join the Resistance. The Shogun's Army retreats from this clash. The way is open for Act III, in which the Traveler meets Kokomi on Watatsumi Island and becomes active in the Resistance's operations (see Omnipresence Over Mortals).

Placement: Released in Version 2.0 as the second act of Chapter II, following The Immovable God and the Eternal Euthymia and followed by Omnipresence Over Mortals (Version 2.1). The act requires the player to have completed Act I of the Grus Nivis Chapter (The Whispers of the Crane and the White Rabbit) and Act I of the Carassius Auratus Chapter (Dreamlike Timelessness).

806.comment: Stillness, the Sublimation of Shadow: The Hundredth Vision Hunt Victim
806.content: Thoma is seized by the Tenryou Commission to be the hundredth person whose Vision is confiscated under the Vision Hunt Decree, in a public ceremony at the Statue of the Omnipresent God where the Raiden Shogun appears personally. The Traveler and Paimon intervene because Ayaka cannot without compromising the Yashiro Commission's neutrality.

807.comment: Stillness, the Sublimation of Shadow: Fight of Honor
807.content: A ceremonial contest before battle in which each side puts forward its best warrior. Gorou explains that a win can give a weaker side a boost in morale. Sara offers it intending to capture the Traveler if they lose. The Traveler's consecutive wins encourage the Resistance.

808.comment: Stillness, the Sublimation of Shadow: Teppei at the Resistance Camp
808.content: Teppei is the Resistance soldier the Traveler rescues from Shogunate troops. He guides the pair, shows them the camp and reinforces its weak points when an attack makes him suspect a traitor. He is frustrated that his logistics work does not let him fight. His fate unfolds in the next act and is not part of this act.

809.content:
Submerged Dragon, Soaring Phoenix (also: Zhangsun Jijing's Raincutter challenge, Plumwatcher Piles challenge): A Version 6.5 world quest set in Luyang Academy, the painting gallery inside the Temple of Space. The Traveler meets Zhangsun Jijing, a Guhua Clan swordsman, and passes three small agility trials he sets.

The Traveler restores a painting on the boat with Dex and then talks to the figure who leaps about inside it. He explains that no rain falls in this realm, so he cannot practise his master's Raincutter sword arts, and trains his lightfoot technique instead. He asks the Traveler to show their skill on the Plumwatcher Piles, then through roof-leaping, then in the air.

Plot: At Luyang Academy the Traveler restores the painting on the boat with Dex, the Temple of Space guide, and sees an ink blot on a pillar. Touching it brings out Zhangsun Jijing, a Guhua Clan sword practitioner. He is polite and formal, and asks why he was called; Paimon says they were only curious about his jumping.

He says he was practising lightfoot techniques because rain never falls in the realm, so he cannot train the Rain Cutter arts his master taught him. He recalls the Great Master Guhua, who sharpened his agility on stone piles and reached the peak of his art, and asks the Traveler for a demonstration. Paimon, jokingly addressed as the master of the Paimon Clan, is amused.

There are three trials, each with a timed Geo-particle goal. First the Traveler steps over the Plumwatcher Piles, then performs the Leaping Techniques (roof-running and wall-scaling, which Zhangsun says the ancient Guhua masters used to scale city walls), and finally the Cloud-Striding Techniques, a legendary secret art said to have let Guhua tread the air and rise through purple haze. Paimon suggests the Wind Glider as the nearest equivalent.

Revelations: Little is revealed. Zhangsun says he is a disciple of the Guhua Clan, that his master passed down the Rain Cutter arts, and that his sect's ancient masters mastered roof-running, wall-scaling and, by legend, walking on air. He is hampered by the absence of rain in the Temple of Space. The Plumwatcher Piles are an exact copy of the ones in front of Wangshan Hall on Mt. Lingmeng, the Guhua Clan's base (wiki trivia).

Characters: Zhangsun Jijing: earnest, courteous and formal, speaks in a stilted martial-arts register, and treats the Traveler as a fellow practitioner. The Traveler and Paimon supply the lighthearted tone. Dex's ability to restore paintings starts the quest. Guhua is mentioned only as the revered founder figure of the clan.

Consequences: Completing the quest unlocks the achievement "Where Now Lies the Raincutter's Hidden Light?" and lets players find Zhangsun at Luyang Academy afterward. There is no wider effect on the story.

Placement: Released in Version 6.5 (Luna VI, 2026-04-08), set in the Temple of Space at Luyang Academy. The wiki states it requires completing Long Live Life, part of the A Long Day in the Mountains chapter, which opens the academy. The quest has no place in a main story sequence.

810.comment: Submerged Dragon, Soaring Phoenix: Zhangsun Jijing
810.content: Zhangsun Jijing is a Guhua Clan disciple and open-world NPC at Luyang Academy in the Temple of Space. Known as the Rainbearer, he trained in the Raincutter sword style and cannot practise it fully because it never rains there. He asks the Traveler to demonstrate lightfoot, leaping and gliding skills in Submerged Dragon, Soaring Phoenix. The wiki describes him as one of the Uplifted preserved as living memories in the Temple of Space.

811.comment: Submerged Dragon, Soaring Phoenix: Plumwatcher Piles
811.content: The Plumwatcher Piles are the stone pillars on which the Guhua Clan trains lightfoot techniques. The set at Luyang Academy copies exactly the ones in front of Wangshan Hall on Mt. Lingmeng. In the quest, Zhangsun calls them the pride of Guhua, and he says Great Master Guhua once honed his agility on them.

key: Summertide Scales and Tales Event Quest
The Story Begins in a Forest Without Rain
They Once Walked the Starry Sky
Until the End of the World
812.content:
Summertide Scales and Tales (also: Summertide Scales and Tales Event Quest, The Story Begins in a Forest Without Rain, They Once Walked the Starry Sky, Until the End of the World, Simulanka storybook event): Summertide Scales and Tales is the Version 4.8 summer flagship event. A strangely bound book sends the Traveler and Paimon into Simulanka, a fairytale world of paper animals and toy people made by three goddesses, where Nilou, Navia and Kirara are also stranded and the Wanderer turns out to be the prophesied Hero. The "evil dragon" they must face is a lonely child named Durin, whose curse they lift by blessing him.

The story runs in three Pages and an Appendix (Afterword): The Story Begins in a Forest Without Rain, They Once Walked the Starry Sky, Until the End of the World and Afterword. It is a self-contained fairytale pastiche, light comedy until Durin's memories are shown. The event's reward character was Kirara.

Plot: The Traveler and Paimon open a mysterious book and wake in Simulanka. In the Forest of Blessings Nilou has become the prophesied Forest Fairy and Grandpa Almond believes the Traveler is the Hero. After restoring the Calligraphy Tavern's Magic Tonic they travel to Constellation Metropole, where Navia is King, and on to the end of the world to face the dragon. There the Wanderer, the real Hero, learns the dragon's story, and everyone's blessings turn him into a small, harmless Mini Durin.

**Page I.** In the Forest of Blessings the paper folk are fading because the Calligraphy Tavern, source of their Magic Tonic (ink), closed after a dragon attacked. Nilou, dressed as the Forest Fairy, learns that magic here is made of words, brews new Tonic, brings a paper hamster to life as Padisarah and reopens the Tavern.

**Page II.** By the Maritime Express the party reaches Constellation Metropole, where Navia is King. The city's tracks (a gift of the Goddess of Prophecy that rewinds people out of danger) are failing and the dragon has stolen its stars. They recover the stars and ride the Aerial Express to hang them back.

**Page III.** The Wanderer, the real Hero of Simulanka, leads them to the dragon's lair. The dragon's memories show a lonely child. After the Wanderer names him Durin, everyone's blessings shrink and uncurse him.

**Afterword.** Two days later friends from Teyvat holiday in Simulanka, and Mini Durin leaves with the Wanderer to visit Teyvat.

Revelations: The "evil dragon" is Durin, a child created and then left alone, and Simulanka was made by three friends who loved M's stories.

Durin's mother M created him with a name that would tie him to a "real-world namesake's" sad fate, hoping a happier ending would be possible in a storybook. His fear and loneliness, not malice, caused his rampages.

Characters: Traveler, Paimon, Nilou (the Forest Fairy), Navia (King of Constellation Metropole), Kirara (the Nekomata-in-Boots), Wanderer (Hero of Simulanka) and Durin (Mini Durin).

Locals include Almond, Citrus, Stream, Firecracker, Padisarah, Wheel and the toy guards Montagne and Bizerte. The goddesses are Alice, B and M. Afterword guests are Kaeya, Jean, Klee, Albedo, Collei, Mona, Fischl and Oz.

Consequences: Durin becomes the small dragon Mini Durin, no longer cursed, and sets out to make amends. The Traveler, Nilou, Navia, Kirara and the Wanderer can leave through the Broken Sea boat or the Cliff of Prophecy's bookmark. The Wanderer promises to bring Mini Durin to Teyvat on the boat "The Durin".

Placement: Released in Version 4.8 on 17 July 2024 (UTC+8) and run until 28 August 2024. Page II unlocked on 19 July, Page III on 21 July and the Appendix on 23 July. It is an event story rather than an Archon Quest, though Navia (president of Spina di Rosula) takes a leading role.

813.content: Simulanka is a storybook world created by three goddesses: Creation (Alice), Prophecy (B) and Fate (M). The Forest of Blessings is home to paper-folded animals who drink Magic Tonic (ink) to keep their colour. Constellation Metropole is a clockwork city of toy people ruled from a castle with an Astral Garden at its peak, with a statue of the Goddess of Prophecy. At the end of the world lies the Broken Sea and the dragon's lair. Players can leave Simulanka via the Broken Sea boat or the giant bookmark at the Cliff of Prophecy.

814.comment: Summertide Scales and Tales: Durin of Simulanka
814.content: Durin is the dragon created by M, who gave him a name tied to a sad real-world namesake. He grew up lonely, frightened the capital, took the Metropole's stars because they reminded him of his mother, and lived behind the waterfall while others sheltered at the Broken Sea. The Wanderer, Nilou and the others blessed him, shrinking him into Mini Durin; he now apologises, rebuilds and befriends Klee, who calls him her big brother because their mothers were friends.

815.comment: Summertide Scales and Tales: Magic Tonic and the Fading Disorder
815.content: In the Forest of Blessings the paper residents' colours and memories fade unless they drink Magic Tonic, which is made from sunsettias, snapdragons and Nilotpala Lotuses brewed into ink at the Calligraphy Tavern. Nilou realises the Fading Disorder is ink running dry. A giant ink bottle sits under the Tavern, and Nilou's blessing reopens it.

816.comment: Summertide Scales and Tales: The Goddesses of Simulanka
816.content: Alice made the world habitable and made origami frogs talk, B (Barbeloth) mapped every fate and has her statue in the capital, and M wrote the fairytales. M expected a short life. Mona recognises the Goddess of Prophecy's statue as her own master.

key: Like Rhyme and Song, the Summer Reverie
817.content:
Summertime Odyssey (also: Golden Apple Archipelago event, Summertime Odyssey event, The Golden Apple Vacation Returns, Immernachtreich Apokalypse, Like Rhyme and Song, the Summer Reverie): The invitation traces back to Alice, with Venti secretly in on it. The archipelago has been seeded with a Fatui experiment, a machine named Cognitive Mimicry, which warps minds; the Fatui who tested it went mad, but the protagonists' stronger wills shaped their hallucinations into stable mirages. The story visits Kazuha's regrets over his clan, Xinyan's struggle to be a musician, Mona's burden as an astrologer and Fischl's relationship with her "Immernachtreich" fantasy. At the end the machine is repaired and switched off, and a mysterious voice, implied to be the future Dendro Archon, speaks to the Traveler.

Plot: Act I, The Golden Apple Vacation Returns!: Fischl, Mona, Xinyan, Kazuha, the Traveler and Paimon travel to the archipelago after Fischl receives an anonymous letter (really Alice's) offering her a land to restore her kingdom. On arrival, Kazuha and the Traveler find a strange Fatui machine.

Act II (Kazuha): a bonsai pot belonging to the Kaedehara family opens a domain recreating Kazuha's childhood. Act III (Xinyan): a vine-covered drum on the Broken Isle opens a domain of her memories and turns the island into an instrument again. Act IV, Immernachtreich Apokalypse (Fischl): Fischl's imagined kingdom, its three-volume book and her double. Act V, The Ancient Azure Stars (Mona): a star-chasing mirage through her years as an astrologer.

Act VI, Like Rhyme and Song, the Summer Reverie: the party finds the Fatui researcher Persikov, recovers the cores of his machine "Cognitive Mimicry", repairs and disables it, and hears the unseen voice a second time.

Revelations: Fischl's imagination is part of herself, not a flaw: Oz says Immernacht Fischl and the child Amy are two sides of the same person. Kazuha admits a wish to continue his clan's bonsai tradition. Mona decides destiny cannot be rewritten but can be seized. The Fatui machine and the unseen voice are separate causes of the mirages, and the voice's Dendro symbol foreshadows Sumeru.

Characters: The Traveler and Paimon, Fischl (and her raven Oz), Mona, Kazuha, Xinyan and Venti (by communicator). Alice and Klee are involved offstage. Persikov leads a hapless Fatui group. Raven statues of the Immernachtreich include one named Arnold, and Immernacht Fischl is the boss-like double of Fischl. The sentient boat, named Miitoboru by Paimon, appears.

Consequences: The machine is switched off; the mirages remain for a while. Fischl feels secure in her imagination, Kazuha and Xinyan and Mona each resolve a private regret, and the group enjoys the rest of the holiday. The voice's final words suggest a future meeting.

Placement: Released in Version 2.8 as a Flagship Event; players needed Adventure Rank 32 and the Chapter II Prologue (Autumn Winds, Scarlet Leaves), with Mona's Beyond This World's Stars recommended. It was set before Sumeru's release in Version 3.0.

818.content: A limited map of islands reached by a Dodoco-themed device outside Mondstadt. In the 2.8 event it holds Pudding Isle, the Broken Isle, Twinning Isle and Minacious Isle, a Fatui camp and the mirage domains. It is also where the Midsummer Island Adventure took place.

819.content: A Fatui machine designed by the researcher Persikov, said to be modelled on a god's power and able to alter brains. After it broke, its crystalline cores were lost. Those weak in willpower hallucinate and go mad; Kazuha, Xinyan, Mona and Fischl instead shaped stable mirages. The group retrieves the cores and fixes it.

820.content: Fischl's imagined kingdom, here a domain with raven statues, narration and a three-volume book. It shows the child Amy and her parents' changing response to fairy tales. Immernacht Fischl, her double, calls it a tomb for those who cannot face reality, but the real Fischl reclaims it.

821.comment: Summertime Odyssey: The unseen voice on the Dodocommunication Device
821.content: Alice's prototype communicator, handed to the Traveler by Venti. In Acts IV and VI an unknown voice takes over the connection, says the mirages are the "deep dream" of humans and that it may meet the Traveler in another place; a Dendro symbol appears. The wiki treats this as implying the Dendro Archon Lesser Lord Kusanali, but the event does not say so.

822.content:
Sunny Summer Fontinalia (also: Sunny Summer Fontinalia Story Quest, Should We Meet Again, Those We Have Lost, Those We Have Kept, A Homecoming film, Luna VIII summer event): Sunny Summer Fontinalia is the Version 6.7 (Luna VIII) summer event and its three-act story quest. At Fontaine's Fontinalia Film Festival the Traveler and Paimon help Xavier's Musketeer Pictures film a story about Columbina, who is visiting Fontaine while searching for her lost best friend. On the borrowed ship Wingalet they find Sandrone alive again, calling herself Miss Guillotin, and help her reach her dead creator Alain Guillotin's flooded home, resolve the "anomalies" in her core and mend an old Fontaine wound.

The acts are Should We Meet Again, Those We Have Lost and Those We Have Kept. The event itself was an aquarium-management game (Operation Deep-Dive Treasure, Kaleido-Catch, Curio Ledger) rewarding the character Charlotte and her outfit Hurlock Variations. The story quest stays playable after the event ended.

Plot: Xavier rewrites his festival film around Columbina and borrows the Wingalet from Wriothesley, but its renter, Miss Guillotin, is Sandrone. She tells the Traveler and Paimon that Alain's final gift revived her. They dive for Alain's home, find her creator's formula, and Sandrone faces her inner "anomaly". She then puts a corrupted mass of wandering souls to rest, reunites with Columbina, and the film gets its happy ending.

**Act I, Should We Meet Again.** Xavier is looking for a new subject after Columbina wanders into his auditions. Chiori and Furina support the rewrite, and Wriothesley lends the Wingalet. Aboard are Citlali (front desk worker) and Sandrone (the ship's renter, using Alain's family name). Sandrone tells the Traveler and Paimon that Dottore destroyed her core in Nod-Krai and that Alain's built-in "Final Gift" rebooted her when a Stellar Linchpin appeared. She wants to find Alain's home, now underwater, and the Traveler offers to dive with her while the crew films.

**Act II, Those We Have Lost.** The party locates the Hidden Dwelling and finds Alain's letter, a formula for meeting her inner "anomaly", and a handwritten note from her earlier years. Sandrone, with the Traveler and Paimon witnessing, faces her own grief and accepts it.

**Act III, Those We Have Kept.** Sandrone destroys the Tower of Gestalt's accumulation of wandering souls, reunites with Columbina on camera, and the film gets its ending. At a party aboard the Wingalet friends gather, and Wriothesley keeps the aquarium.

Revelations: Sandrone survived the Nod-Krai battle; Alain Guillotin prepared a built-in "second chance" that triggered when a Stellar Linchpin appeared.

The Stellar Linchpin let her core reboot and repair. Pulonia, the other half of Alain's work, is beyond repair, though some of its algorithms and the numerological array were imported into her body. A formula Alain left lets her meet and accept her inner "anomaly", the clash of her emotions and logic.

Characters: Traveler, Paimon, Columbina, Sandrone (Miss Guillotin), Citlali, Furina, Chiori, Xavier and Wriothesley.

Charlotte, Chevreuse, Navia, Emilie, Clorinde and Lepine-Pauline appear in the film crews. Act II features Alain Guillotin in flashbacks, and Tartaglia, Capitano, Signora and Arlecchino appear in Sandrone's memories of tea parties. The finale party adds Neuvillette, Sigewinne, Lyney, Lynette, Freminet, Escoffier, Ninette, Veronique and Baptiste.

Consequences: Sandrone resolves her "anomalies", reunites with Columbina and the Fatui circle, and visits Alain's grave. The Wingalet's aquarium remains, since Wriothesley asks to keep some installations for the inmates at the Fortress of Meropide. Xavier's "A Homecoming" does not win the Furina Award, which goes to "Great Detective Hurlock".

Placement: Released in Version 6.7 (Luna VIII) on 1 July 2026 as a flagship event running to 11 August 2026 (UTC+8). It is a permanent story quest in Fontaine (the event page notes it can still be accepted after the event). It follows the Nod-Krai events and precedes the version 7.0 Snezhnaya story.

823.content: A large vessel kept at the Fortress of Meropide, brought up to the Court of Fontaine for the festival and rented out for extra income. Its maintenance is done by inmates. Sandrone rented it as captain and turned it into an aquarium that Wriothesley keeps afterward.

824.comment: Sunny Summer Fontinalia: Hidden Dwelling and Alain's Final Gift
824.content: The Hidden Dwelling is Alain and Sandrone's old home, now underwater, with a garden, workbench, water-insulating sluice gates, a fireplace and a puzzle table. Alain's built-in "Final Gift" revived Sandrone and left a Multidimensional Algorithmic Core, a letter and a soul-mapping formula.

825.comment: Sunny Summer Fontinalia: Stellar Linchpin (Sandrone's account)
825.content: According to Sandrone, a Stellar Linchpin is a rare kind of Vision, linked by Fatui research to the Third Descender, whose manifestation seems to fix impurities from his remains in place. It lets its user channel elemental energy with an unusual power from beyond Teyvat.

826.comment: Sunny Summer Fontinalia: Wandering souls at the Tower of Gestalt
826.content: A mass of resentful, severed souls had gathered at the Tower of Gestalt in the Morte Region and was fusing with evil beings. Sandrone reversed her world-formula to separate the souls and returned them to the Ley Lines, saying she did it to fulfil Alain's wish to repair things with his friend Rene.

827.comment: Sunny Summer Fontinalia: A Homecoming and Great Detective Hurlock
827.content: "A Homecoming" is Musketeer Pictures' festival film about a woman searching a foreign land for her lost friend, directed by Furina with Columbina as the lead. "Great Detective Hurlock", directed by Lepine-Pauline with Charlotte as the lead, adapts a popular light novel and wins the Furina Award.

key: The Surprise That Awaits Us All
A Curtain Call for a Colorful Summer Night
828.content:
Sunspray Summer Resort (also: Sunspray Summer Resort Story Quest, To a Carefree Vacation, The World Is Your Canvas, The Surprise That Awaits Us All, A Curtain Call for a Colorful Summer Night): Sunspray Summer Resort is a Natlan story quest released in Version 5.8 alongside a limited-time flagship event (30 July to 18 August 2025). The Traveler and Paimon holiday at the new Easybreeze Holiday Resort with Bennett, Mualani and Chasca, later joined by Venti. During the holiday Bennett meets the spirits of his birth parents.

The quest has four parts: To a Carefree Vacation!, The World Is Your Canvas!, The Surprise That Awaits Us All! and A Curtain Call for a Colorful Summer Night! The event offered four gameplay modes and rewards such as Bennett's outfit Adventures in Blazing Hue and the claymore Flame-Forged Insight. Unusually, the story quest stays playable after the event ended.

Plot: Bennett, Mualani, Chasca and the Traveler test the new resort. After rest, painting and challenges, a blurred photograph leads Bennett to an Abyssal domain, where Venti helps him reach the spirits of his parents. A party on Tete Isle and a quiet farewell follow.

**Part I, To a Carefree Vacation!** The Traveler and Paimon receive a letter inviting them to the resort's trial operation, with food, lodging and entertainment covered. Bennett, whose luck has unexpectedly improved, greets them with a friendly Asha companion. Mualani and Chasca arrive by sea. The group tries the Dreambow Drift, buys candles for a "sun" offering at a market stall, eats at Huha Hill and holds a bonfire ritual in which each makes a wish. Bennett wishes the land healing and his dads in Mondstadt health.

**Part II, The World Is Your Canvas!** The group tackles three areas of the resort (Colorfall Cliffs, Guiztli Ridge and Wavey Bay), then visits Tete Isle, where the Traveler acts as DJ on a dance-off stage Xilonen designed and the group colours the stage with the Asha.

Revelations: Bennett was born in Natlan to a retired adventurer couple, and the spirits of his parents are now Asha.

His parents, Aroni and Macani, belonged to Tecpatl's Flintblades. When Abyssal monsters attacked the team in the Mare Jivari, his mother stayed behind to save him. The Mondstadt adventurers who raised him gave him the name Bennett, which means "blessed". The parents lost their memories as Asha, and the album's photos were taken by Aroni.

Characters: Traveler, Paimon, Bennett, Mualani, Chasca and Venti.

Also Mavuika, Rhythmos, resort staff such as the candle seller Nataba and Ukucha (who gives out the challenge prize), the Asha, and Bennett's parents Aroni and Macani. Ororon and Ifa are at the resort checking on the health of saurian staff and aphids, and Xilonen designed the stage.

Consequences: Bennett makes peace with his past and chooses to return to Mondstadt. The group takes a commemorative picture with the cry "Lucky star!"

Placement: Released in Version 5.8 on 30 July 2025 (UTC+8) as a flagship event with timed phases. The event required Adventure Rank 18 and the Prologue Act III. After the event ended the story quest remained available at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort. It does not appear in the Archive's Story Quests list.

829.comment: Sunspray Summer Resort: Easybreeze Holiday Resort
829.content: A newly opened holiday resort in Natlan staffed by locals, with Asha as its mascots. It held a trial operation and invited the Traveler. Areas include Huha Hill, Colorfall Cliffs, Guiztli Ridge, Wavey Bay and Tete Isle.

830.content: Aroni and Macani belonged to Tecpatl's Flintblades, a Natlan adventurer team that retired when two members had a baby. After Abyssal monsters attacked in the Mare Jivari, Aroni stayed behind to save the child. Both later lost their memories as Asha. In Part III they briefly appear to Bennett and say they are proud of him.

831.content:
Swords and Secrets (also: Vesna's world quest, Vesna's sword spirits, Ancient Sword Esoterica quest, Druzhna Special Dispatch Order quest): Swords and Secrets is a lighthearted 7.1 world quest starring Vesna, Commander of the Druzhna. After a rare Liyue "manual" teaches her to make sword spirits, they escape and start causing trouble around Snezhnaya. The Traveler and Paimon help her hunt them down over seven days. The manual is revealed at the end to be an unfinished work of fiction from Yae Publishing House. The reward is the Druzhna Special Dispatch Order.

It unlocks after White Night, Like a Dream Upon Waking, and takes seven real-time days because one part opens each day. Completing it gives Primogems, 30,000 Mora, Hero's Wit, Guide to Glory, the cosmetic Construct Appearance Flutterwing and the Druzhna Special Dispatch Order, which makes a sword spirit fly beside Vesna when she is in her Coursing state. The tone is comedic, and the cast of sword spirits are caricatures of cultivation tropes.

Plot: Vesna's flying sword turns out to be one of several sword spirits she accidentally created while following a book bought from a rare-book dealer. Each has "mastered" a different cultivation art, and each is caught in turn. The last, a Greater Sword Spirit with two Volkodlak followers, makes a last stand on the Everfrozen Earth, and Vesna ends up sparing its group and giving them a second chance.

Day 1: A person named Blyushko shouts that a thief has struck at Sadov-Arbat; the Traveler chases a flying blue-green blur to Vesna, who admits it is one of her creations. She had bought an ancient manuscript from Liyue about people who cultivated mind and body to command flying swords, and tried the method; the sword spirits flew off, and one stole the second half of her copy of the "Ancient Sword Esoterica". She does not want to send the Druzhna because the unit is stretched and she hopes to clean it up quietly.

Days 2-5: Vesna makes a "Divine Sense Compass", which Paimon points out has nothing to do with divine sense because she uses her own elemental energy. Spirits found: the Master of Potions, who brewed an "immortal elixir" that turns out only to be sweet; the Master of Body, tricked into staying in a cauldron until it passes out; the Master of Sigils, who paints a portrait of the one person Vesna fears, which she defaces and glues in place; and the Master of Artifacts, a machine body based on a Landcruiser which the party defeats in battle.

Revelations: The "Ancient Sword Esoterica" is not a real cultivation manual. A cutaway shows Mr. Nine at Yae Publishing House, with a collaborator, discussing a draft work of fiction whose author and researcher disagree over whether to keep its adepti hierarchy consistent; the draft was only circulated within the publisher and shelved. Vesna had bought the books in a clearance lot of Yae Publishing House stock. Post-quest, the Greater Sword Spirit admits it could not read all of the Liyue script and took gaps as hidden mysteries.

Characters: Vesna (Commander of the Druzhna), Danica (Her Majesty's head housemaid), Odette and Vodyanitsa of the Korolevskiy Theater, Blyushko, the Greater Sword Spirit and its followers "Second of the Pack" and "Third of the Pack", the Masters of Potions, Body, Sigils, Artifacts and Sound, Mr. Nine, the Traveler (Cryo) and Paimon.

Vesna is playful, impulsive and quick to cut corners, yet carries real responsibility and a firm sense of justice. Danica is stern and dry; she watches over Vesna's affairs. The Greater Sword Spirit is dramatic and speaks in cultivation-novel verses, but is loyal to its followers.

Consequences: Vesna's escaped sword spirits are all recaptured; the Master of Sound stays at her side, and the Greater Sword Spirit and its followers now help with Druzhna paperwork, in the Greater Sword Spirit's words, having laid down weapons and taken up the pen. Vesna learns the manual was fiction and the Druzhna avoid a larger scandal. The dispatch order gives her a sword spirit companion.

Placement: Released in 7.1 (the first patch version after Snezhnaya's launch in 7.0), unlocked by completing White Night, Like a Dream Upon Waking. One part is available per day for seven days. Some dialogue changes after A Rekviem for the Underworld. A trial Vesna and Traveler (Cryo) are used in some steps.

832.comment: Swords and Secrets: Vesna's sword spirits
832.content: Vesna's sword spirits are semi-sentient flying swords she created while experimenting with a manual; each is drawn to a different "art" such as potions, body tempering, sigils, artifacts or sound. They are comic, grandiose and easily thwarted, and each embodies a wish of Vesna's. All are recaptured by the end, and the Master of Sound stays with her.

833.comment: Swords and Secrets: Ancient Sword Esoterica
833.content: A Liyue-style manuscript describing Sword Immortals who cultivate body and mind, command flying swords and nurture sword spirits. Vesna bought it cheaply from a rare-book dealer who had bought a clearance lot from Yae Publishing House; it is actually an unfinished novel by Mr. Nine, never printed.

834.comment: Swords and Secrets: Druzhna Special Dispatch Order
834.content: A quest reward item usable only by a player who owns Vesna; once used, a small green sword spirit flies beside Vesna whenever she is in her Coursing state, and cannot be turned off.

key: Tale of Dreams Plucked From Fire
elixir that can cure all injuries
835.comment: Tale of Dreams Plucked From Fire
835.content:
Tale of Dreams Plucked From Fire (also: Tracer No Tracing, Seeker No Finding, Chikya's treasure hunt, elixir that can cure all injuries): Both quests are lighthearted and character-driven. Chikya, a self-described Phlogiston Usage Tutor, uses ancient woven scrolls to lead the party past Phlogiston Engravings and Spiritdoors, relying on the Traveler's ability to read phlogiston directly. The goal she names, a cure-all elixir, is not what she finds; the Sage's gift is a spring that grants a chosen hero the power to wield phlogiston. Chikya herself, who cannot use phlogiston because of an old Abyss-related injury, gets nothing from it except a little back relief.

Plot: Tracer No Tracing. The quest begins in the Underground Lava River beneath the Ameyalco Waters Statue of the Seven, either by talking to Chikya or by defeating a Secret Source Automaton: Hunter-Seeker at the end of a hallway. Chikya's back seizes up as she meets the party, and she introduces herself with a joke about giving a fake name. She says she hunts treasure: an "elixir that can cure all injuries" described in a secret scroll, which she offers to split. She explains Phlogiston Engraving, a language of patterns that imitates how dragons controlled phlogiston, and says analysing one door would take her a day. The Traveler reads it directly with phlogiston and learns that an Unveiling Script is needed; the party finds one (a Koholasaurus can retrieve it) and the door half-opens. Deeper in, past a Spiritdoor and Spiritway among lava, they find a clay ring with phlogiston patterning that opens the way to the Upper Sanctum. This door needs three Unveiling Scripts, one of which is already lit, and the party gathers the rest. Chikya waits because of her back, and a Fluid Avatar of Lava guards one of them. They ride the Spiritway to the surface.

Seeker No Finding. Chikya admits she left her tribe without telling friends or family. At the Upper Sanctum, floating islands held up by phlogiston, she asks the Traveler to activate mechanisms while she consults her memory of the scrolls. Touching Iridescent Inscriptions makes them vanish, each with a short message. After a Spiritway trial, a previously hidden island appears at the centre. At a large stone tablet only the Traveler and Little One notice faint words and a golden pattern. Reaching out to it triggers a fight with Avatars of Lava. Afterwards the water in the spring is full of phlogiston and warm.

Revelations: - The Sage's gift at the Upper Sanctum is a hot spring that fills with phlogiston, which grants a chosen hero the ability to wield phlogiston; it is not a medical cure-all.
- When Paimon accuses her of knowing this, Chikya does not deny it: she says no single elixir could heal every injury and admits she tricked Paimon, framing it as a lesson.
- Chikya cannot use phlogiston at all, which is rare in Natlan. She blames a grave Abyss-related injury from early childhood.

Characters: Chikya is the main non-player character: a talkative woman of the Masters of the Night-Wind who looks after old woven scrolls and teaches children about phlogiston, with chronic back pain and a habit of awarding or deducting points for the Traveler's answers. Little One, the Tepetlisaurus companion, reacts and sometimes seems to sense where a Script is. Paimon asks the questions and gets teased. The Traveler is the one who reads and activates phlogiston.

Consequences: Chikya stays to rest in the spring and says that her back hurts less than after the People of the Springs' baths, though her real goal is still far off. The first quest rewards 250 Adventure EXP, 30 Primogems, 20,000 Mora, 2 Hero's Wit and 3 Mystic Enhancement Ore; the second gives 300 Adventure EXP, 40 Primogems, 30,000 Mora, 2 Hero's Wit, 3 Mystic Enhancement Ore and an Iridescent Inscription Fragment. Both grant 200 reputation with the People of the Springs.

Placement: Released in Version 5.0 as a Toyac Springs world quest series, starting at the Underground Lava River beneath Ameyalco Waters. Seeker No Finding follows Tracer No Tracing directly. No prerequisites are listed for either.

836.comment: Tale of Dreams Plucked From Fire: Chikya
836.content: Chikya is a Masters of the Night-Wind woman who tidies and studies ancient woven scrolls and calls herself a Phlogiston Usage Tutor. She cannot use phlogiston because of a severe childhood injury linked to the Abyss, which fuels both her scholarship and her regret. She is chatty, self-mocking and optimistic, wants to be called "Big Sis", and left her tribe without telling anyone to go on this hunt.

837.comment: Tale of Dreams Plucked From Fire: Phlogiston Engraving and Unveiling Scripts
837.content: In Chikya's account, Phlogiston Engraving is a language of patterns humans developed by imitating how dragons controlled phlogiston, after the Sage of the Stolen Flame stole its seed. Doors with engravings open when the required Unveiling Scripts, themselves engravings, are integrated. Scholars like Chikya can read them by comparing patterns over about a day; someone able to use phlogiston can read the meaning directly.

838.comment: Tale of Dreams Plucked From Fire: The Upper Sanctum trial
838.content: Called Hanan Pacha in the Natlan tongue, the Upper Sanctum is a group of floating islands held up by phlogiston and described by Chikya as a pure land of peace made by the first human to use phlogiston. The trial involves activating mechanisms and Iridescent Inscriptions with phlogiston, riding Spiritways and revealing a hidden central island, where a battle against Avatars of Lava closes the trial.

key: Encounter in the Realm of Dreams
839.content:
Tapirus Somniator Chapter (Yumemizuki Mizuki) (also: Tapirus Somniator, Yumemizuki Mizuki's Story Quest, Dream Eater's Melancholia, Encounter in the Realm of Dreams, Crisis at the Aisa Bathhouse, A Deceit Called Happiness, Descendant of Nightmares): The Tapirus Somniator Chapter is Yumemizuki Mizuki's Story Quest, released in Version 5.4, and as of 7.1 it has one act, Dream Eater's Melancholia.
